title: Motor Winding Insulation Test (Megger) — Pakistan 2026 Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete Pakistan 2026 guide to motor winding insulation testing using meggers. Covers PI/DAR ratios, IEEE 43-2013 vs PS:596 test voltages, temperature correction for Pakistan's 45-55°C summer ambient, PKR tester prices, SRD import duty, and 7 Pakistan-specific insulation failure risks including loadshedding thermal cycling, rewound motor baseline problem, cotton-dust contamination, and VFD common-mode voltage attack. Essential for predictive maintenance in Pakistani factories.
author: CNC Electric
